name: Atal Pension Yojana
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
target_group: Indian citizens aged 18–40 who meet current APY conditions
eligibility: Must have a savings bank/post office savings account
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension options of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60, depending on the chosen contribution/pension slab and applicable rules.
application_process: Open/enrol through a participating bank or post office.
